create_json_storage: create a JSONStorage instance to load, get, set, and remove tasks from a single tasks.json file
create_dir_jsons_storage: create a DirJSONsStorage instance to manage individual JSON task files in a directory with caching
create_external_tasks_json_storage: create an ExternalTasksJSONStorage instance for cloud-synced task storage with thread-safe set and remove operations
create_annotations_dir_storage: create an AnnotationsDirStorage instance to store annotation JSON files in an annotations subdirectory
test_json_storage_remove: test JSONStorage remove and remove_all methods to delete tasks by id from the tasks.json file
